people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “How long do you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws?
translations.bsb: Then the LORD said to Moses, “How long will you refuse to keep My commandments and instructions?
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?
